correctness.rationale: The budburst date is uniquely solved from a quadratic cumulative spring forcing integral. Its warming derivative equals -1+R with R unimodal on positive cold margins. Exact tangency elimination gives the unique b_c and sign regimes, and a nonzero second derivative with positive parameter derivative yields the square-root fold. The boundary at zero cold margin has matching first derivatives. Symbolic local derivatives and 11288 checker assertions corroborate—but do not substitute for—the proof.

value.rationale: The sharp transition gives an explicit, testable separation between guaranteed advancing phenology and a finite warming-induced delay window in a recognizable cold/chill plus forcing mechanism. The at-most-two bound and square-root onset constrain numerical sensitivity studies; the finite triangular winter realizes both turns inside a bounded warming interval. It is a model benchmark and makes no unsupported field-level prediction.
